{{- /* Moves every heading of a Markdown string one level down (`## Remarks` -> `### Remarks`), for a member's content placed under its own `##` heading in its parent symbol's Markdown version. Lines inside code fences are content, not headings, and stay as written. Expects: the Markdown string. Returns it with the headings demoted. */ -}} {{- $inFence := false -}} {{- $closer := "" -}} {{- $lines := slice -}} {{- range split . "\n" -}} {{- $line := . -}} {{- with findRESubmatch "^[ \t]*(`{3,}|~{3,})(.*)$" $line 1 -}} {{- $marker := index (index . 0) 1 -}} {{- if $inFence -}} {{- if and (eq (substr $marker 0 1) (substr $closer 0 1)) (ge (len $marker) (len $closer)) (eq (trim (index (index . 0) 2) " \t\r") "") -}} {{- $inFence = false -}} {{- end -}} {{- else -}} {{- $inFence = true -}} {{- $closer = $marker -}} {{- end -}} {{- else -}} {{- if and (not $inFence) (findRE `^#{1,5} ` $line) -}} {{- $line = printf "#%s" $line -}} {{- end -}} {{- end -}} {{- $lines = $lines | append $line -}} {{- end -}} {{- return delimit $lines "\n" -}}
